title: The empty decision scope is correct; the documentation is what is wrong
context: Criterion c2 was opened on the belief that record_decision fails to derive a criterion N label when given a criterion_id and no scope. Investigation found no derivation in src at all, because it was deleted deliberately on 2026-09-01 in commit 731f4dac, feat(decisions): stop deriving scope, store it as given. The spec files the old behaviour as defect D2 at docs/specs/2026-08-28-continuity-goal-model.md:288: an omitted scope was fabricated from the lowest open ordinal, and decisions being append-only made a wrong stamp permanent. Two passing tests pin the empty string at test/spawn/decisions.test.ts:374-378 and :427-431, and a contract census at test/contract/optional-arguments-are-absent.test.ts:116-130 names criterion 1 as the canonical forbidden derived value. The contradiction is docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:126-127, which still promises the deleted derivation, against that same file's precedence line at 5-6 saying the code wins.
options: Correct docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md to describe what ships: an omitted scope is stored as given and never derived. No source change, no test inverted.
Reinstate the derivation narrowed to an explicitly supplied criterion_id, reversing 731f4dac, inverting two passing tests and amending the contract census.
Strike c2 as founded on a false premise and leave the stale documentation sentence in place.
outcome: Correct the documentation. The narrow reinstatement was rejected on merits even though it breaks no test: an ordinal is a display position recomputed on every criterion insert at src/domain/criteria.ts:112-113, field merge at src/merge/field-merge.ts:181 and conflict repair at src/server/tools/resolve_conflict.ts:294, so a stored criterion N decays silently while the criterion_id already on the link stays correct. That id is not an unwired anchor: src/render/briefing.ts:162-167 reads it to split key decisions into live and settled lanes. Reinstating would therefore re-accept defect D2 in permanent append-only records to duplicate a pointer that is already right. c2 is struck and replaced by a documentation criterion. The identical stale sentence in the global copy at ~/.claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md:131 ships as its own pull request, because installing a global rule puts it in force immediately.
